               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="">'byung she</rs> na re 'di khyes brgyud ma yin te *gap* bo de la rgyal med pa yin pas byes bskus mi srid de zer ro <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="">slob dpon</rs> na re phyogs 1 nas de ltar yin pa srid kyang rtso ba'i rgyu'i skabs 'dir 'grel pa rtsoms pa'i rgyu cig don gyi rdogs ma lus pa yod zhes zhal kyis bzhes <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="6a5"/>pas na kyes rgyung du spog pa ti ka <expan>thams cad</expan> las byas byes ba rgyu du byaso gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
